maps.divergesFromUpstream: This copy is the upstream map with exactly three engine-authored fields, and nothing else: status, raised from 'mapped' to 'implemented' on every entry the engine implements and whose tests were each shown to fail; implementedIn, naming the ruleset and version that implements it; and tests, naming the tests that prove each implemented entry with the mutation that turned each one red. All three are build facts, which only the engine can know: issue #17 in rules-factory names the first two as the legitimate divergence, and tests (rules-factory #2) is the verdict that status now requires. docs/corpus-map.md does not itself say which fields a consumer owns, so tests is treated as engine-owned by the same reasoning as #17. Everything else matches the upstream bytes field for field -- locator, kind, scope, clarity, dependsOn, enabledBy, suspendedBy, derivedFrom, crossReferences, absentFrom, evidence, ambiguity, beyondAdapter and note. Corrections this build found are recorded in MAP-FINDINGS.md and accepted upstream, never applied here alone.
maps.whyPinned: The map is the oracle scripts/validate.sh validates the code against, and the engine writes into it. Unpinned, an edit to the oracle would look the same as an edit to the code passing.
